status: feature-owned optional seam; no production caller enrolled

api.combat_session_update: CombatSession::update keeps existing callers source-compatible and accepts an optional caller-supplied RetainedFrameAudioClock.
api.clock_sample: Exact WinMM TIME_SAMPLES device_samples + QPC monotonic nanoseconds + output generation, copied from the same AudioDeviceClockV40 captured and published to the one recovered V42 runtime.
api.observer: Optional per-session observer receives same ActorId and RetainedAnimationEvent plus the actual zero-based frame.events index and validated caller sample. It runs after named_animation_event succeeds and before motion handling.
api.failure: Absent/unready clock is typed unavailable_clock and the observer is not invoked. Required provider absence is distinct required_owner_unavailable. Playback diagnostics and exceptions are recorded and never change the gameplay event/frame return.
api.lifecycle: Observer is transient and blocks lifecycle checkpoint validation until cleared through clear_lifecycle_services; it is not serialized.

validation.compiler: LLVM-MinGW clang++ C++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -static; linked the recovered V42 runtime, one PlatformSourceAudio, WinMM output, and winmm.
checks: A hardware-captured TIME_SAMPLES/QPC/generation pair exactly matches the sample published to the same V42 AudioClockV40.
Unfocused, invalidated/unpublished, and focus-lost V42 clocks do not produce a valid RetainedFrameAudioClock; failed snapshot output is cleared.
The observer receives the supplied actor, actual event ordinal, and exact sample.
Absent or rejected samples do not invoke the observer and return typed unavailable_clock.
Required-owner failure remains a distinct typed diagnostic.
A playback diagnostic does not veto retained-frame dispatch, and the gameplay callback remains first; a failed gameplay callback prevents observer invocation.
CombatSession translation unit compiles with LLVM-MinGW strict warnings; its legacy missing-field-initializers are suppressed for this compile-only check.

boundaries: No main.cpp caller/provider exists; no live production audio enrollment is claimed.
The caller must pass a clock captured for the same output frame; this change does not synthesize or choose the frame sample.
The observer callback wiring is optional and not currently connected to CanonicalSourceAudioAdapter in production.
The existing actual WinMM hardware output smoke remains the same single V42 runtime; no second router/mixer was added.
